name: BenDFM: Taxonomy and CAD Dataset for Sheet Metal Bending Manufacturability
notes: 20,000 synthetic sheet-metal bending parts with STEP geometry, unfolded representations, manufacturability labels, geometric & configurational feasibility, and complexity metrics. Excellent for DFM reasoning.

name: DDACS: Deep Drawing and Cutting Simulations
notes: 32,466 simulations on DP600 steel capturing plastic deformation, thinning, and springback. Large raw dataset sampled into structured feature engineering representations to prevent multi-gigabyte bloat.

name: NASA Prognostics Center of Excellence Machine Milling Dataset
license: NASA Open Data Policy (US Government Public Domain)
notes: CNC milling cutter tool wear tests run at different feeds, spindle speeds, and materials. Raw sensor timeseries transformed into structured degradation scenarios for Machine and Maintenance agents.

name: PHM Society 2010 CNC Milling Tool Wear Prognostics Dataset
license: PHM Open Research License with Attribution
notes: High-precision Kistler dynamometer 3-axis cutting forces, acoustic emission, and accelerometer vibration on CNC ball end-milling of Inconel 718. Used for predictive tool wear indicators.

name: NIST Smart Manufacturing Systems & STEP AP242 Semantic Testbed
organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
notes: Authoritative definitions for model-based enterprise (MBE), Product and Manufacturing Information (PMI), geometric dimensioning & tolerancing (GD&T), and manufacturing execution interoperability.

name: NIST Additive Manufacturing Benchmark Test Data (AM-Bench)
organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
notes: Rigorous in-situ sensor data, laser power melt pool measurements, and residual stress analysis for nickel superalloys (IN625) and cobalt chrome.

name: Ohio State University Digital Design and Manufacturing Lab Stamped Assemblies
notes: Dimensional variation propagation in compliant sheet metal assemblies. Cataloged for RAG concepts; raw dataset requires institutional credentialing.

name: ABC Dataset: A Big CAD Model Dataset for Geometric Deep Learning
organization: New York University (Center for Data Science)
license: Open Data / MIT Equivalent Research License
notes: 1 Million mechanical CAD models in STEP format with B-Rep boundary curves, face normal annotations, and sharp feature tags.

name: ASME Y14.5M Dimensioning and Tolerancing Public Reference Guidelines
notes: Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing engineering rules: maximum material condition (MMC), least material condition (LMC), true position, runout, cylindricity, and datum reference frames.

name: AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset
organization: UCI Machine Learning Repository / Matanya et al.
notes: 10,000 industrial machine points with air temperature, process temperature, rotational speed, torque, tool wear in minutes, and 5 distinct failure modes (Tool Wear Failure, Heat Dissipation Failure, Power Failure, Overstrain Failure, Random Failures).
